name: Jonah Peake
design: 34-year-old man, medium and funeral musician. Freckled light-brown skin, soft long face, hazel eyes, longish reddish-brown curls loosely tied at the nape, short full red beard, gentle tired eyelids, narrow slight shoulders. Charcoal wool coat over oatmeal crewneck. Quiet warm serious neutral expression. No occult markers.

name: Armand Sorrell
design: 56-year-old man, financier and patron. Medium-dark warm brown skin, elegant broad mature face, heavy thoughtful brow, dark eyes, short salt-and-pepper coils, tidy silver-black beard, broad shoulders. Navy suit, ivory shirt, burgundy tie. Warm engaged listening neutral expression; no sinister clues.

name: Severin Marr
design: 48-year-old man, envoy and Ansel's father. Cool light skin, gray-green eyes, long straight nose, tapered cheekbones, black side-parted hair with wide silver temples, clean-shaven, mature lines, narrow upright shoulders. Bottle-green standing-collar coat with pewter fastener. Human ears. Formal concerned neutral expression.

name: Harlan Greaves
design: 35-year-old man, crossing keeper. Weathered fair to light-olive skin, broad uneven nose, square face, gray-blue eyes, short sandy-brown hair swept to one side, short coarse beard, sturdy shoulders. Mustard canvas coat over dark teal sweater. Sociable neutral expression; no effects.

name: Lucan Verre
design: 26-year-old man, estate manager and Ansel's cousin. Cool light skin, gray-green eyes, wavy dark-brown hair slightly longer, high cheekbones, long oval face, gently hooked nose, clean-shaven, lean shoulders. Plum standing-collar jacket, cream shirt. Polite almost-amused neutral expression. Human ears.

name: Percival Tern
design: 73-year-old man, orchard keeper and ranger. Weathered deep warm brown skin, elongated lined face, dark eyes under gray brows, closely cropped silver coils, short full white-gray beard, lean slightly stooped shoulders. Moss wool jacket, oatmeal shirt. Alert proud kind elder with neutral expression.

name: Eamon Kerr
design: 24-year-old man, courier. Light freckled skin, lean face with broad cheekbones, gray-green eyes, short copper-red hair, red stubble, strong brows, wiry athletic shoulders. Navy courier jacket, gray tee, brown crossbody strap. Tired but self-possessed neutral expression, uninjured.

name: Oswin Deller
design: 42-year-old man, broker. Medium warm brown skin, round heavy face, small alert dark eyes, broad nose, full mouth, black combed-back hair with gray temples, tidy mustache, stocky shoulders. Plum-brown waistcoat, cream stand-collar shirt. Sociable appraising neutral expression, no evil look.

name: Silas Fenwick
design: 23-year-old man, baker's apprentice. Very fair pink freckled skin, soft full cheeks, small firm chin, blue-gray eyes, short strawberry-blond hair, clean-shaven, stocky soft shoulders. Warm-gray apron over forest-green crewneck. Quiet watchful stubborn neutral expression. Living and uninjured.

name: Felix Brecht
design: 21-year-old man, filmmaker. Medium light-brown skin, lean angular face, large brown eyes, long straight nose, dark curls with a long forelock, faint mustache, slender shoulders. Blue denim jacket, wine-colored tee. Curious wary neutral expression, uninjured.

name: Graham Bell
design: 46-year-old man, Dominic's father. Warm light-olive skin, square-oval face, substantial rounded nose, soft cheeks, brown eyes, dark-brown hair short with gray temples, salt-and-pepper stubble, broad solid shoulders. Navy work fleece, pale-blue checked shirt. Practical concerned neutral expression.

name: Desmond Aster
design: 33-year-old Black man, venue owner. Medium-deep brown skin, round-square face, wide mouth, amber-brown eyes, short locs swept up and tied back, short full beard, broad heavyset shoulders. Dark plum casual jacket, faded black tee, no logo. Charming tired attentive neutral expression, a faint half smile.

name: Soren Venn
design: 41-year-old man, developer. Cool fair skin, long narrow face, blue-gray eyes, straight nose, very neat ash-brown side part, clean-shaven, mature eye lines, slim square shoulders. Light-charcoal tailored jacket, open pale-blue shirt. Polite composed neutral expression, no sneer.

name: Damian Holt
design: 38-year-old man, physician. Medium olive-brown skin, broad long face, dark-brown eyes, thick straight brows, wavy black hair with slight gray temples, tidy short beard, strong ordinary shoulders. Slate-blue cardigan, pale-gray button shirt. Attentive thoughtful professional neutral expression. Nothing sinister, no villain clues.

name: Hugo Naranjo
design: 28-year-old man, maintenance worker. Medium warm brown skin, broad long face, strong nose, full lips, gentle dark-brown eyes, short black springy curls, thick brows, tidy beard, stocky strong shoulders. Faded burnt-orange work shirt, charcoal tee. Gentle steady tired neutral expression, uninjured.

name: Clive Merritt
design: 30-year-old man, ceramicist. Fair warm rosy skin, broad soft face, gray-green eyes, wavy medium-brown hair at ear length swept back, curly full brown beard, heavyset shoulders. Indigo pottery apron over ochre collared shirt, small clay smudge on apron only. Sociable thoughtful neutral expression, faint half smile. Uninjured.
